title: 剣をかえっこ勇者
concept: 攻撃するたび敵と剣が交換され、強い剣で殴るほど次は敵がその剣を持つ。敵の予告を読み、今の威力で攻めるか守って気合をためるかを選ぶ。体力と薬を四戦に持ち越し、借りた強さをいつ返すか考える小さな冒険。
howToPlay: 攻撃すると敵と剣を交換。守ると被害を1以下に抑え気合+3。敵の予告を見て、薬2本で四戦を越えよう。
libraryDecision: 交換前後の数値と予告を読む戦闘が核。Canvasの平面表示が適し、物理や3Dの追加は判断を明瞭にしないため使わない。音は標準Web Audioの短い音で十分な反応が得られる。
soundDecision: 攻撃は短い金属音、守りは低い音、勝利は高い音にする。ターンを急かさないようBGMは入れない。

candidates.idea: 攻撃のたび敵と武器が交換されるRPG。強い剣を渡すタイミングと守りで得る気合を読む。
candidates.ideaEn: An RPG where every attack swaps weapons with the enemy; plan when to hand over strength and build focus by guarding.

candidates.idea: 透明な花びらを重ねて注文の色を作る花屋。
candidates.ideaEn: Overlap translucent petals to mix flower orders.

candidates.idea: 岸へ寄せて返す波に合わせて石を置くリズムの庭。
candidates.ideaEn: Place stones in rhythm with incoming and retreating waves.

en.title: Sword Swap Hero
en.concept: Every attack trades swords with your enemy: using a strong weapon hands that strength to your opponent. Read the forecast and choose between attacking now or guarding to build focus. Carry health and two potions through four battles.
en.howToPlay: Attack to trade swords. Guard caps damage at 1 and adds 3 focus. Read enemy intent and survive four battles with two potions.
en.libraryDecision: Flat Canvas clearly shows weapon values and enemy intent. Physics or 3D would not clarify these decisions. Standard Web Audio provides sufficient brief feedback.
en.soundDecision: Metallic short attack tones, low guard tones and a higher victory tone confirm turns. No music pressures the player to hurry.

aiReview.comment: 9手を画像で確認。攻撃後の剣と反撃威力の交換、守りの被害軽減と気合、第一戦勝利、次戦への体力持ち越し、薬の消費と回復を確認した。強い剣を返す判断は面白いが、敵が同じ三手周期なので守って気合をためる形に寄りやすい。四戦クリアや敗北・再開までは未確認。

similar.title: Dicey Dungeons
similar.note: 小さな数値と装備でターンごとの攻防を選ぶ。本作にダイスや装備収集はなく、敵との剣の交換に絞る。
similar.note_en: Both use compact equipment values for turn-based combat. This game omits dice and collecting gear, focusing on trading swords with the enemy.

similar.title: Slay the Spire
similar.note: 敵の次の行動を見て攻撃と防御を選ぶ点が近い。カードやデッキはなく、交換後の敵の威力が変わる。
similar.note_en: Both use revealed enemy intent to choose offense or defense. There are no cards or decks here, and trading swords changes retaliation strength.

aiReview.research: 2件のWeb検索後、Dicey Dungeons公式Wikiの装備説明と、Slay the Spire開発者インタビューの敵意図表示の説明を確認した。

en.comment: Viewed nine steps. Confirmed sword swapping and changed retaliation, guard mitigation and focus, first-battle victory, carried HP, and potion healing/consumption. Handing back a strong sword creates a decision, but the fixed three-turn enemy cycle favors repetitive focus-building. Did not reach final victory, defeat or restart.
en.research: Ran two web searches, then checked equipment on the official Dicey Dungeons wiki and enemy-intent discussion in a Slay the Spire developer interview.

aiReview.method: スマホ縦画面で 9 手プレイ（時間を止めて1手ずつ操作）
aiReview.methodEn: Played 9 moves on a portrait phone screen (time frozen between moves)

playLog.note: 攻撃で剣を交換する説明を読み開始する。
playLog.noteEn: Read that attacking trades swords and start.

playLog.note: 敵は構えるので攻撃が来ない。守って気合を3ためる。
playLog.noteEn: The enemy prepares without attacking. Guard to build three focus.

playLog.note: 気合が3になった。敵に弱い剣2を渡す攻撃を選び、反撃も弱めたい。
playLog.noteEn: Focus is three. Strike while handing the enemy my weak sword, reducing its retaliation.

playLog.note: 敵に5ダメージを与え反撃は2だった。強い剣を保つためここは守る。
playLog.noteEn: Dealt five and took two after the swap. Guard to keep the strong sword.

playLog.note: 気合込みで8、敵は残り7。攻撃でこの戦いを終える。
playLog.noteEn: Eight attack power versus seven enemy HP. Strike to finish the battle.

playLog.note: 敵を倒せた。体力と剣を持ち越して次へ進む。
playLog.noteEn: Enemy defeated. Continue and inspect carried health and sword.

playLog.note: 体力15と剣2が持ち越された。敵が構える間に薬を飲み回復を確認する。
playLog.noteEn: Fifteen HP and sword two carried over. Drink a potion while the enemy prepares.

playLog.note: 薬で上限18に回復し残り1本。二回の守りで攻撃をしのぎ、気合を上限6までためる。
playLog.noteEn: Potion restores HP to eighteen and leaves one bottle. Guard twice through the two incoming attacks, building focus to six.

playLog.note: 二回の守りで失う体力は2、気合6。安全な構えのターンに8の攻撃を使う。
playLog.noteEn: Two guards cost two HP and build six focus. Use the eight-power strike on a safe preparation turn.

metrics.method: Codexのtoken_usage_recordをresponse_idで重複除去し企画開始から自己判定完了まで集計。入力はキャッシュ込み、出力から思考を控除。ツールはトップレベル呼出のみ。
metrics.methodEn: Aggregated Codex token_usage_record entries by unique response_id from planning through review. Input includes cached tokens; output excludes reasoning. Tools count top-level calls only.
